accessibility.evidence: Named filters expose aria-pressed. Enter opens a product and Escape restores card focus. Decorative icons are aria-hidden; disabled purchase buttons cannot dispatch a transaction.

responsive.evidence: Browser assertions show no page overflow at all three viewports. Inspected mobile shop and desktop achievements: shared line icons, readable numbers, fixed page size and compact three-column mobile cards.

loading.reason: The draft catalogs are local static definitions; no remote progress or transaction request is made.

empty.evidence: The six collapsed planned definitions explicitly say progress is not tracked. The shop says purchases are not active. Active cosmetic achievements are verified separately in achievement-rewards/evidence.json.

error.reason: No network read or mutation drives the static shop or collapsed draft definitions; the active achievement page has separate error evidence in achievement-rewards/evidence.json.

partial.evidence: Filtering Common shows four items, Legendary five; pagination displays 12 then seven items. Filtering from the second page resets it.

success.evidence: Guest and signed-in journeys passed: loadout link, catalog filters, keyboard dialog, merge to 4, pagination, achievements and responsive captures. Catalog references and translations pass the focused schema test.

permission.evidence: Neither guest nor account browsing sends any REST mutation. The fictional account remains equipped with Classic; purchases are disabled.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop shop preserves its planned prices and disabled purchase control; the two achievement-only boards are excluded.
Four-column catalog reuses numeric tile art and separates planned prices from active free access.
Three-column mobile catalog stays inside the viewport with wrapped filters and 12-item pagination.
